messages:
talia: Brainstorm: "Refapp Bootcamp Roadshow" 1 - 4 live mini-sessions across different time zones to seed contributor traction and collect demo leads. Targets: 900 repo clones, 200 webinar regs, 40 qualified leads :loudspeaker:
mike: Love it. Keep it modular: each session = 30m hands-on + 15m office hours. Use the same repo but different 'challenge tracks' (chat, embeddings, low-cost deploy).
harrison: For the launch post we should lead with a compact benchmark box: cost + median latency for a dev workstation (CPU/low-GPU) vs hosted. I'll draft a 3-line narrative and a small chart for the blog.
suzie: Tutorial breakdown: 1) clone & run a minimal server (10m), 2) swap in a quantized variant and run bench script (15m), 3) push to sandbox + call /generate (10m). Put prework at top of README.
talia: Webinar ops: proposed dates: Tue Jul 12 11am PT / Thu Jul 14 6pm CET / Sat Jul 16 9am SGT / Mon Jul 18 4pm ET. @remy can you host the infra demo and failover scenario?
remy: Yep. I'll demo a graceful fallback: overrun -> route to smaller quantized variant, and a quick bit showing how to enable prefix caching via config. I'll prepare a short recorder for the fallback so we have a backup clip.
mike: Messaging note: avoid corporate-speak. Dev-first angle: "Ship a working LLM demo, measure cost, and optimize latency in under an hour." Include explicit commands and sample numbers.
harrison: Proposed benchmark snippet for blog (we'll polish): "Local q4 - p95 180ms, hosted - p95 90ms; token cost local ~$0.002/request vs hosted ~$0.006 (varies)." Add an asterisk about hardware variance.
suzie: Assets: launch blog, 3 short GIFs (bench before/after, deploy flow), repo with CONTRIBUTING + issues for bench submissions, landing page, 3-email drip. I can take GIFs + landing.
mike: For the tutorial repo I'll add a tiny perf helper: `python microbench.py --model rdx-mini-q4 --reps 20` that outputs mean/p95/p99 + tokens. Example in README.
mike: ```bash
# microbench example
python microbench.py --model rdx-mini-q4 --prompt "translate: hello" --reps 20
# prints mean_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens
```
talia: Lead routing: include checkboxes on the form for "Interested in dedicated capacity trial" and "Want a concierge sandbox demo". Add a hidden `utm_campaign=bootcamp_roadshow` for SDR segmentation. Also request company size and primary use-case.
remy: SDR ask: include an optional checkbox "I want a follow-up on infra/SLAs" so we can triage to the enterprise flow. Also surface the repo stars and demo interest in the lead payload.
harrison: For the blog benchmark narrative, I'll prepare two small visual callouts: one for chat flows, one for embeddings. Each will have a short note about where quantization helps most.
suzie: Can we add a community leaderboard in the repo? Top 10 contributors with badges -> encourages PRs. We'll also add an issue template "bench result" so folks can drop CSV outputs.
bot-campaigns: campaign created: refapp-bootcamp-roadshow, landing draft: https://redwood.example/bootcamp-roadshow (owner: talia)
talia: Action items: talia -> blog + landing copy (Wed), suzie -> GIFs + landing & email cadence (Thu), mike -> microbench + README snippet (Wed), harrison -> benchmark bullets + two visual callouts (Thu), remy -> infra dry run + failover clip (Fri). Dry run Mon Jul 4 9am PT (20m).
remy: I'll script the overload scenario and record a short fallback video in case the live demo hiccups. Also prepping a small K8s sandbox deploy playbook for the workshop.
talia: Good. Let's keep all updates here. If anyone needs a hand on copy, ping me. :thumbsup:
